doc.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Road bands and the Gillespie band
title: Joining the Dizzy Gillespie band
summary: Gillespie sends for him in 1948 to replace James Moody; he stays about two years.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: ...musicians, we would get up and study our instrument, our craft–music–how we could excel. That was the art of the day, and this went on for years. Uh finally, in ’48 uh the Dizzy Gillespie band returned from Europe without James Moody, who had just had a, just hit Moody’s Mood For Love.
And Diz sent for me to join the band. I joined them in San Francisco, and I stayed with them for about two years, and I returned to Detroit in ’50.
